# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> de Courcy Estate Agents are delighted to offer for sale No 13 Vereker Gardens located in a mature and well-established cul de sac development situated only a 5-minute walk to the city centre and adjacent to the award winning 4-star Strand Hotel. Both TUS Gaa Grounds and Thomond Park Rugby Stadium are an easy walk and with endless host of amenities given the close proximity to Limerick City Centre.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 138 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: 13 Vereker Gardens, Ennis Road
